display_information.name: Flag Reaction Translator
display_information.short_description: If you add a flag sticker to a message, it will be translated into that language.
display_information.long_description: When you apply a flag sticker to a message in a different language, the text will be translated into that language and displayed as a message visible only to you. Please note that stickers other than flags are ignored. Currently supported languages are Japanese (🇯🇵), English (🇬🇧, 🇺🇸), and Vietnamese (🇻🇳). We use the Cloud Translation API for translation.
